title: Nyehelo e Fetotseng Qetello
intro: Mehleng ea pele ea botho, moea o ne o fana ka mpho ka sepheo se hloekileng. Leha ho le joalo, mohono o ne o ipatile moriting oa kamohelo. Fumana pale ea motho enoa eo boinehelo ba hae le qetello ea hae e bohloko li sa shoeng tšenolong ea bomolimo.
clues: Ke ne ke le har'a meloko ea pele ea moloko oa batho.
Ke ile ka hlahisa nyehelo ho Morena oa ka, 'me ea amoheloa ka mohau.
Nyehelo ea moena oa ka e ile ea haneloa, 'me mohono oa fifatsa pelo ea hae.
Ka re ho eena, 'Haeba u ka otlolla letsoho la hao ho 'na ho mpolaea, nke ke ka otlolla letsoho la ka ho u bolaea; ka 'nete ke tšaba Allah, Morena oa lefats'e.'
Ke ile ka ba mohlaseluoa oa ketso ea pele ea polao lefatšeng.
Mali a ka a ile a hoeletsa, 'me ke ne ke le moshoela-tumelo oa pele oa ho hloka molato.

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
